title: German nuclear tests seen over the Baltic

tellings.quote: Um, there are some eyewitness reports of two German nuclear weapons tests being conducted between late 1944 and early 1945.

plain: Germany may have tested two nuclear weapons over the Baltic Sea between late 1944 and early 1945. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels there are "some eyewitness reports" of these tests, without naming them. If true, it would mean Nazi Germany had working atomic bombs before the United States did.
